svg.title: Seed procedure: make an existing progression explicit
svg.desc: Only four step numbers are added in existing card margins. All original words, card order, geometry, typography, colors, photograph/crop, paper and lighting remain identical. The underlying sequence Fill, Close, Seal, Label is unchanged. Fictional seed-library instruction sheet.
